description.value: A well-appointed national park campground set in cedar-hemlock rainforest at the foot of the Meadows in the Sky Parkway, just 5 km from downtown Revelstoke — and 2 km by bike — with hot showers, flush toilets, and potable water on site. Both a campsite fee and a National Park pass are required for overnight stays.

address.value: Meadows in the Sky Pkwy, Revelstoke, BC V0E 2S0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Parks Canada website confirms Snowforest Campground is an active, reservable campground in Mount Revelstoke National Park with 62 sites, operating May–October 2026. Website explicitly lists potable water, hot showers, kitchen shelter, food lockers, and electricity. The campground is notably only 2km from downtown Revelstoke by bike or on foot, making it very accessible to touring cyclists. No hiker/biker-specific sites are mentioned, nor are laundry, vending, or cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Parks Canada campground just 2 km by bike from downtown Revelstoke with full amenities including showers, potable water, kitchen shelter, and food lockers — an excellent stop for touring cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor.
